# Ship Index Grow

> A practical six-week product launch school: AI-assisted development, UX, SEO/GEO, distribution and automation. Founding cohort: 20 participants. Each participant works on their own digital product. Enrollment dates are confirmed by email; submitting the form does not take payment.

## Language versions
- [English](https://shipindexgrow.top/): Program, six-week curriculum, projects, format, pricing and application.
- [Українська](https://shipindexgrow.top/uk): Практична онлайн-школа створення продуктів із ШІ, UX, SEO/GEO, просування та автоматизації. Від ідеї до власного запущеного продукту.

## Pricing
- English: USD 490 for the complete six-week program.
- Ukrainian: UAH 25,000 for the complete six-week program.

## Curriculum
1. Validate idea, audience and value proposition.
2. Design UX, prototype and brand system.
3. Build with AI and deploy on a domain.
4. Prepare SEO/GEO, content and analytics.
5. Plan distribution, outreach and acquisition.
6. Automate repeatable workflows with human oversight.

## Live case studies
- [Interface Report](https://interfacereport.com/): Editorial architecture and discoverability.
- [RIDNE](https://ridne.store/): Marketplace UX, trust and operations.
- [Oleh Hebel & Co](https://olehhebel.top/): Productized services, conversion and lead generation.

## Blog (English)
- [How to Build and Launch a Product with AI in 6 Weeks](https://shipindexgrow.top/blog/build-and-launch-a-product-with-ai/): Week-by-week plan from idea to a live, indexed product with AI coding tools.
- [GEO in 2026: How to Get Cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI](https://shipindexgrow.top/blog/geo-get-cited-by-ai-search/): Generative engine optimization checklist.
- [AI Agents for Solo Founders](https://shipindexgrow.top/blog/ai-agents-automation-for-solo-founders/): What to automate after launch, with a human in the loop.
- [How to Get Your First 100 Users](https://shipindexgrow.top/blog/first-100-users-after-launch/): Free distribution plan for an AI-built app with no users.
- [Security Checklist Before You Launch an AI-Built App](https://shipindexgrow.top/blog/ai-built-app-security-checklist/): API keys, database rules, auth, payments, backups.
- [Why Google Isn't Indexing Your New Site](https://shipindexgrow.top/blog/google-not-indexing-new-site/): Search Console statuses, causes and fixes.
